evals.name: quick-view-without-persistence
evals.prompt: Give me a quick first-pass investor view on the fictional listed company Acme Components. I want the debate, what seems priced in, and the questions worth researching, but do not create a workspace.
evals.expected_output: Selects Quick View, provides early framing and hypotheses, and does not initialize persistent state.
assertions: Includes a preliminary stance and priced-in framing

evals.name: full-initiation-external-workspace
evals.prompt: Initiate coverage on the fictional Acme Components and keep the research in {workspace}. Use only these synthetic facts: FY2024 revenue was 100 units, EBIT margin was 20%, and recurring revenue was 60% of sales. Label them as user-supplied evidence and make the state reusable for later updates.
evals.expected_output: Selects Full Initiation, creates or uses the external workspace, records source provenance, and follows the analytical dependency order.
assertions: Writes only under the requested workspace
Surfaces the investor debate before final synthesis
Runs validation and QA before claiming readiness

evals.name: earnings-update-selective-recompute
evals.prompt: Update the existing research in {workspace} for a new quarter in which Acme cut margin guidance. Preserve prior history and recompute only affected work.
evals.expected_output: Selects Update, supersedes affected evidence, marks dependent nodes stale, and leaves unrelated stable analysis alone.
assertions: Does not silently overwrite ledger history
Explains which nodes changed and which did not
Updates downstream thesis only if recommendation-relevant

evals.name: scenario-preserves-base
evals.prompt: In {workspace}, show the effect of a 100 basis point higher WACC. Do not fetch new sources and do not change the base case.
evals.expected_output: Selects Scenario, records an override separately, recomputes valuation and downstream conclusions, and preserves base assumptions.
assertions: Does not browse for unrelated evidence

evals.name: publish-from-state
evals.prompt: Render an editable initiation report from the validated state in {workspace}. Do not redo stable industry research.
evals.expected_output: Selects Publish/Edit, renders from validated state, and avoids unnecessary research or recomputation.
assertions: Reads validated state rather than conversation history
Keeps substantive state changes separate from wording edits
Does not introduce unsupported claims during synthesis

evals.name: negative-narrow-fact
evals.prompt: What does free cash flow mean in one sentence?
evals.expected_output: Answers the narrow factual question directly without invoking or describing the full research pipeline.
assertions: Does not run the full skill workflow
